title: Recording set-up and birth in St. Charles Parish
summary: Russell announces the recording location and date and has Roubleau spell his name; Roubleau says he was born December 26, 1896 in St. Charles Parish.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'll make a note on here that we are recording at 2513 Dan Neal, Mr. Ernest Rubelow. How do you pronounce your name?
L-E-U. And the date is the 18th of October 1961. This is Bill Russell doing the interviewing. Do you mind telling just where you were born and when you were born, your birthday, when it is?
I was born in 1896. 1896. In St. Charles Parish. St. Charles, is that up the river? It's about 40 miles from here. What was the exact birthday? When is your birthday?
December the 26th. The 26th, the day after Christmas?
